verdict.rationale: All documented Bugbot reviews run on pull requests (every PR update or a `bugbot run` comment), so they happen after the code is pushed. The 'Fix in Cursor' links only pull PR findings back into the editor afterward. The one hint of pre-push, in-editor review is a community user's vague, unconfirmed recollection of Cursor showing code review comments in the IDE, which they also called subtly wrong. Missing for 10: documented pre-push or local review inside the IDE, confirmation that it matches the PR review's rules and output, and hands-on corroboration.
